title: MUSCLE MANGA - "Tiger Killer" Orochi Doppo's Physique in Grappler Baki
summary: A scripted Muscle Manga episode on Orochi Doppo, NH's favourite Grappler Baki character, based on Kyokushin founder Mas Oyama. NH covers real full-contact karate, Doppo's thick 178 cm / 110 kg physique at 55, his defeat and revival, and how relentless hard work over 45 years rather than talent defines him.
claims: Karate has a poor reputation in the West due to McDojos, but in Japan it remains respected and deadly; Kyokushin is full-contact
Mas Oyama sent three black belts to fight Muay Thai fighters in Thailand in 1964 and two of them won
Orochi Doppo, NH's favourite Grappler Baki character, is based on Mas Oyama
Doppo's physique is thick and functional rather than aesthetic: thick waist, well-developed abs, powerful limbs and a huge back, at 178 cm and 110 kg
Doppo keeps this physique at 55, showing that age means more experience and practice, not decline
Oyama showed a great physique while focusing more on performance in martial arts
Doppo wasn't talented or a fast learner; hard work and step-by-step perseverance over 45 years made him great
Oyama's teaching: vigorous training is more about forging a resolute spirit that conquers the self than about building a strong body
Doppo is inspiring because he is fallible and emotional, not an enlightened-warrior cliché, so his mastery seems within reach
Doppo stepped down as Shinsekai president because the leadership role interfered with his true pursuit of perfecting karate
